pattern.short_summary: A character specification — a name, personality, social role, or narrative voice — is attached to the generative agent and held constant across its turns.
pattern.definition: A character specification — a name, personality, social role, or narrative voice — is attached to the generative agent and held constant across its turns. It is treated as a design element that can be set, swapped, or compared, independent of the task the agent performs.
pattern.structural_signature: A persistent specification slot, separate from turn-level content, is applied to every generated turn. Changing only that slot changes the voice and role of all subsequent output while task, inputs, and every other interface element stay fixed; the slot is a controlled variable of the system, not a property of any one response.

dimension.category_description: How human and artificial participants are personified, assigned visible roles, coordinated, simulated, or represented to one another.
dimension.classification_boundary: Identity or social organization must be user-facing; invisible multi-agent division of labor is excluded.
